description: This file defines a MapStruct mapper interface for converting LoanChargeData objects to Avro data transfer objects used in Fineract's external event serialization for loan charges.

classes.name: LoanChargeDataMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct interface for mapping LoanChargeData to Avro representations for serialization in external services.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a LoanChargeData object into a LoanChargeDataV1 Avro object, ignoring externalOwnerId and customData fields.

methods.name: mapRangeView
methods.description: Returns a LoanChargeDataRangeViewV1 Avro view of a LoanChargeData object.
